sloka: स त्रिभिर्नैर्ऋतश्रेष्ठैर्युगपत् समभिद्रुतः।न विव्यथे महातेजा वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।। ६.७०.१२ ।।
transliteration: sa tribhirnairṛtaśreṣṭhairyugapat samabhidrutaḥ।na vivyathe mahātejā vāliputraḥ pratāpavān ।। 6.70.12 ।।

translations.english: Eminent and highly energetic son of Vali did not feel perturbed when three of the foremost Rakshasas attacked him together.
